# Discovery report

## Executive summary

Re-keying is the largest problem. Anna Lindqvist said so.

> I type every PDF invoice into Procountor by hand

> Our customers love the new AI chatbot we built last year

She told us “it takes about three hours a day” and that it is the worst part.
